answer: Each agent identity must solve a 2^30-hash proof-of-work puzzle and submit the solution to the registry as objective evidence; the operator pays an irreversible 0.5 kWh compute cost per key, so N fake identities cost 0.5N kWh linearly, not a refundable lockup. A jetty, plume, or atlas alias cannot reuse the old proof, and key rotation burns the fee anew.
